'''Edra Kothe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the beginning of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Marriage/Legends|Married]] to [[Neven Kothe]], Edra and their partner had a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] son named [[Ardun Kothe|Ardun]] who was born<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3696 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|2}} The Codex entry for [[Ardun Kothe]] states he is 54 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, and as he is first encountered in Act II, which takes place in 3642 BBY, that means that Kothe was born in [[3696 BBY]].</ref> and Ardun was recruited into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during his childhood.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Due to fragmentary records, [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] was unable to determine whether Edra and Neven had fled to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] when the Great Galactic War began<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3681 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Edra Kothe was mentioned in the Codex entry for Ardun Kothe in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
